visibleText:

Proposition 423: Vail Unified School District budget override continuation

Proposition 423 asks voters in Vail Unified School District No. 20 whether the district may continue to exceed its state revenue control limit by up to 12.5% per year, starting with fiscal year 2027/2028 and for the six fiscal years after that. It is a continuation of an existing budget override, not a new one. According to the district's Notice of Election, that would put the district's budget about $5,102,762 above the alternate budget for 2027/2028, at an estimated continuation cost of $1.61 per $100 of secondary assessed valuation. The district's governing board adopted the resolution calling the election on June 2, 2026, and it appears as a special election consolidated with the November 3, 2026 general election. A "yes" vote is for continuing the override and a "no" vote is against it; arguments for and against were due to the Pima County School Superintendent by August 7, 2026.
